notes.title: Natural Instincts releases in Early Access!
notes.content:
Hello Rangers! 
Before you are allowed into the Safari park to become the best warden in Africa, we have one more challenge for you. Taking care of wild animals requires a lot of passion and dedication. You need to ensure their safety and help them survive. For now, [b]European forest and its inhabitants await you[/b] in the new upcoming strategy game called [b]Natural Instincts which releases this Thursday, July 22, in Early Access! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40222129/f5016b545376e5ea0c0168fb7776d7b83d14a77d.png[/img]

[h3]Natural Instincts[/h3]
Get to know [b]the lives and struggles of wolves, rabbits, or even wild boars[/b] with these short yet complex stories. [b]Keep the dangers away from the animals[/b] and help them breed so their packs, colonies, and families can grow. Be careful, though, as [b]the balance in the environment is very fragile.[/b]
You can lead the animals to extermination or bring balance and multiply their population. It all depends on you!

[b]Natural Instincts on Steam:[/b] https://store.steampowered.com/app/1168610/Natural_Instincts/

[h3]First European forests, then African safari![/h3]
Become a warden of European forests to understand wild animals' needs and challenges they need to face every day. Prepare yourself for taking care of Safari park residents as you try to keep wild forest animals away from danger. Face different disasters, react to human presence and help the animal kingdom flourish in this unique, environmental experience!

Stay safe,
Natural Instincts Team
